sentences.en: The construction workers are pumping slurry out of the excavation.
sentences.zh: 建筑工人正在把坑里的泥浆抽出来。

sentences.en: Be careful, the floor is slippery because of the spilled slurry.
sentences.zh: 小心，地上都是泥浆，很滑。

sentences.en: The cement mixer produces a thick slurry that coats the stones evenly.
sentences.zh: 搅拌机搅拌出来的水泥浆均匀地涂在石头上。
